description: This file defines interfaces related to stream checkpointing in the Orleans.Streams namespace, including factory and checkpoint management interfaces for stream queue checkpointing.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a stream checkpointer for the specified partition in the IStreamQueueCheckpointerFactory interface.

methods.name: CheckpointExists
methods.description: Property indicating whether a checkpoint exists in the IStreamQueueCheckpointer interface.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the checkpoint asynchronously in the IStreamQueueCheckpointer interface.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the checkpoint with a new offset and current UTC time in the IStreamQueueCheckpointer interface.
